subject.title: fix(openai): align auth availability with effective routes

question: Should `resolveModelRoutes` and its route/auth/runtime-policy types become a supported permanent public Plugin SDK contract as part of this bug fix?
rationale: The implementation is correct and documented, but publishing a new provider API commits OpenClaw to compatibility behavior that code review and tests cannot authorize on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Approve the public route contract
options.body: Accept the documented SDK types and provider hook, then require exact-head CI/prepare before merge.

options.title: Keep the contract bundled-internal
options.body: Narrow the route resolver to the bundled OpenAI/Codex boundary and defer external Plugin SDK exposure.

options.title: Pause for broader provider design
options.body: Hold the PR until additional provider owners agree on a generalized route/auth/runtime contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the public route contract
recommendation.body: Accept the documented SDK types and provider hook, then require exact-head CI/prepare before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the route contract and has prior merged ownership of the Codex bridge boundary, making him the strongest available decision owner.
